source.author: Manish Krishan Lal
source.title: The Flow-Limit of Reflect-Reflect-Relax: Existence, Stability, and Discrete-Time Behavior
source.date_note: Dates differ between retrieved representations; the review is pinned to the PDF hash.

scope: Abstract, introduction, definitions, tube theorem/corollary statements, selected numerical discussion and outlook. The complete proofs and computations were not independently validated.
comparison: The smooth setting requires a feasible transverse intersection; the numerical example is LEDM. The outlook leaves infeasible global dynamics open. This is related prior work, not an identified copy of the present spatial-circle case.
own_algebra: After aligning projector order, T_beta=x+beta*(P_A(R_B x)-P_B x). Our F_beta=T_beta+(1-beta)*(P_B x-x). Distinct update formulas do not prove lack of a nonlinear conjugacy.
limits: Elser 2025 Chapter 5 body remains unread; the publisher summary and contents do not close that gap.
